criteria.costEffectiveness: Retain useful obligation; no same-quality removal established. Aggregate principles CI/local cost is recorded; per-file current execution cost not invented.
criteria.sufficiency: Separate files: inputs-ref presence does not prove source reading; install-rc historical ratchet admits326legacy candidates as baseline, not correctness certification. New omissions must fail.
